title: Nell and the Log
checkpoint: Reception Autumn 2, week 3 — Learning — Phase 3: new sounds l, ll, ss
note_for_grown_ups: Non-fiction, Phase 3, 29-sound stage (x, y, z just added). A true fact: some wild bees make their nest inside a gap in an old log, not just in hives.

pages.illustration: Close view of Nell the bee resting on a grey log, showing her small body clearly.
Nell the bee humming with wings blurred, perched on the grey log.

pages.text: Lots of bugs sit in a log.
pages.illustration: Several different small bugs sitting together on and around the old grey log.

pages.text: Nell has a den in the log.
pages.illustration: Nell the bee at the entrance of a round gap in the side of the grey log.

pages.text: The den has a gap to get in.
pages.illustration: Close view of the round gap in the log, just big enough to enter.
Nell the bee resting inside the dim den inside the log.

pages.text: Nell can hum in the den.
pages.illustration: Nell the bee humming softly while resting inside the den.

pages.text: Lots of bugs nap in the log.
pages.illustration: Several small bugs napping together inside and around the old grey log.
